messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout for chart=service-external v2.3.1 -> eu-west-1 (canary=5%). Preflight detected secret rotation for external-service-token; marking canary as held. refs: deploy/8122

maria: that's from the scheduled token rotation at 02:00 UTC. we didn't expect the rollout at the same time. sorry for the overlap. :sheepish:

alex: noticed some pod evictions. can we get events?

sre-oncall: quick grep of events shows mounting errors then SecretUpdated: 
```
kubectl -n payments get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 8
Warning   FailedMount    pod/service-external-canary-1 failed to mount secret
Normal    SecretUpdated  secret/external-service-token rotated
```

maria: helm chart currently doesn't wait for secret propagated across nodes. sidecar restart picks up new token, but some nodes still serve older token -> auth fails leading to eviction in init.

samir: options: pin back to v2.3.0 to avoid promoting v2.3.1, or cancel the canary (rollback), or patch chart with hook to wait for secret/rolling update. given customer traffic and change window ends at 03:30 UTC, pin seems safest now.

jen: agree on pin. we'll need a deploy-bot annotation to prevent auto-retry/promote. I'll add release-note line: "Temporary pin to v2.3.0 due to token rotation; hotfix scheduled."

maria: preparing a small values override/hook for hotfix: 
```
serviceExternal:
  rollout:
    waitForSecretPropagation: true
    secretName: external-service-token
    propagationTimeoutSec: 30
```

samir: applying pin: `deploybot annotate release=service-external pin=v2.3.0 reason="secret rotation causing mount failures"`

ops-bot: Action logged: annotation added by samir at 1731234625. Promotion pipeline will skip v2.3.1 until annotation removed.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: chart pinned to v2.3.0 (user=samir). Canary for v2.3.1 cancelled.

sre-oncall: filed INF-4021 to track impacted sessions and hotfix verification steps. adding a small smoke checklist in the ticket.

alex: ping support and include the release-note blurb. plan to hotfix at 03:45 UTC after the window. thanks all. :thumbsup:
